capabilities: Chat with the vault using multi-session Q&A with clickable citations
Summarize the current note or selected text
Surface related notes, semantic search results, and near-duplicates
Compare, merge, and analyze gaps across 2-10 selected notes
disambiguation: Not Qwen-only despite the name; it works with any OpenAI-compatible chat and embedding endpoint.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; a beta channel is available via BRAT. Notes are sent only to the user-configured endpoint; no telemetry or account.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant for vault-wide question answering, semantic organization, or merging content across notes.

relations.evidence: Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, DashScope-compatible mode, one-api/new-api gateways all work.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, or gateway)

summary: Bilingual AI assistant sidebar that chats about your vault with citations, suggests tags, finds related notes, and compares or merges multiple notes.
